text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 29 Mei 2012.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan

yang bermula dari kilometer 0.00 Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan (di koordinat

U 329697.903, T 414938.347 Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)) dan berakhir di

kilometer 32.89 (di koordinat U 320499.948, T 386524.275 Grid Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO)) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari Persimpangan Bertingkat UNITEN),

termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Putrajaya, Persimpangan Bertingkat Wetland,

Persimpangan Bertingkat SKVE, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Ayer Hitam, Persimpangan

Bertingkat SKVE Saujana Putra, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar SKVE Saujana Putra,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Teluk Panglima Garang dan Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Teluk

Panglima Garang, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 32.89 kilometer diisytiharkan sebagai

jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan) 2010

[P.U. (A) 217/2010] dibatalkan.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SOUTH KLANG VALLEY EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (South Klang Valley

Expressway) Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 29 May 2012.

Declaration as a Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the South Klang Valley Expressway

commences from kilometre 0.00 South Klang Valley Expressway (at coordinate

N 329697.903,E 414938.347 of the Rectified Skew Orthormorphic Grid (RSO)) and

ending at kilometre 32.89 (at coordinate N 320499.948, E 386524.275 of the Rectified

Skew Orthormorphic Grid (RSO)) (both the distances measured from UNITEN

Interchange), including Putrajaya Interchange, Wetland Interchange, SKVE Interchange,

Ayer Hitam Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, SKVE Saujana Putra Interchange, SKVE Saujana Putra

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Panglima Garang Interchange and Teluk Panglima Garang

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, being a distance of 32.89 kilometre is declared to be a Federal

road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (South Klang Valley Expressway) Order 2010

[P.U. (A) 217/2010] is revoked.
